About the Role
As a Taxation Accountant, you will play a key role in delivering professional taxation services to a diverse range of government clients, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, regulatory requirements and established service standards.

Working collaboratively with colleagues, client agencies and external taxation authorities, you will prepare statutory returns, undertake reconciliations, research legislative requirements and provide practical advice on complex taxation matters.

You will also contribute to the development of policies and procedures, identify opportunities to improve financial systems and processes, and support quality assurance and risk management initiatives.

  • Prepare and review complex statutory taxation returns, including Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT), Goods and Services Tax (GST) and Payroll Tax (PRT), along with supporting working papers, reconciliations and reports.
  • Provide taxation advice and guidance to client agencies, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, rulings, case law and regulatory requirements.
  • Liaise with clients and external taxation authorities to resolve enquiries, clarify requirements and support accurate and timely reporting.
  • Promote high standards of customer service by responding to enquiries professionally, building strong stakeholder relationships and meeting agreed service delivery targets.
  • Research changes to taxation legislation and rulings, communicate their implications and identify training needs to support ongoing compliance.
  • Contribute to the development, review and implementation of taxation policies, procedures and financial management practices.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve reporting, quality assurance, risk management and business processes.
  • Support colleagues in delivering consistent, accurate and professional taxation services across a broad client base.
  • Analyse financial data and prepare reconciliations, reports and supporting documentation to inform decision-making and maintain compliance.
  • Maintain accurate records in accordance with relevant records management legislation, policies and procedures.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, workplace safety, inclusion and professional integrity.
About You
You are a technically capable taxation professional who combines strong analytical skills with a customer-focused approach. You are confident interpreting complex legislation, managing competing priorities and providing clear, practical advice to a range of stakeholders.
You will bring:
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing complex taxation returns, particularly GST, FBT and payroll tax.
  • A sound understanding of taxation legislation, relevant rulings, compliance obligations and applicable governance frameworks.
  • Experience undertaking financial reconciliations, analysing financial data and preparing accurate reports and supporting documentation.
  • The ability to research complex taxation matters and translate technical information into clear, practical advice.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • A commitment to delivering high-quality customer service, resolving enquiries and achieving timely outcomes.
  • Well-developed organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet competing deadlines.
  • The flexibility and adaptability to respond positively to changing priorities, processes and business requirements.
  • Experience identifying and implementing improvements to financial management, reporting and compliance processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial management systems, including experience using spreadsheets for reconciliations, financial modelling and reporting.
  • A commitment to maintaining accurate records and working in accordance with legislative requirements, professional standards and workplace policies.
  • National Police check

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Our client is one of Australia's largest hospitality groups, operating a national portfolio of pubs, bars and event venues.
The business has grown largely through acquisition. Each venue is run with a local-first approach, tailored to its community rather than following a single template.
About the role
The business needs a demand forecasting model for the venues it has acquired in the last 12 months. You will own that build, from approach through to production.
The core challenge is limited history. These venues have only a short trading record in the company's systems, and earlier data may sit in different point-of-sale systems or be incomplete. You will need to forecast reliably by drawing on patterns from comparable venues across the wider network, then improve the model as each site's own data builds up.
Your forecasts will feed directly into how venues roster staff, order stock and plan trading.
Key responsibilities
  • Design and build a demand forecasting model for recently acquired venues, covering revenue, covers and product demand at daily and intraday levels
  • Solve the cold-start problem by using data from comparable venues, hierarchical approaches and pre-trained time series models where they help
  • Bring in external drivers such as weather, public holidays, school holidays, local events, sport and promotions
  • Clean, align and integrate venue data from different point-of-sale and operational systems
  • Deploy the model to production with automated retraining, monitoring and drift detection
  • Set clear accuracy measures and report performance by venue, region and venue type
  • Work with operations, finance and venue managers so forecasts are understood, trusted and used
  • Document the approach so the model can be maintained and extended to future acquisitions
Essential skills and experience
  • 5+ years in data science, with demand or sales forecasting models built and run in production
  • Strong Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with forecasting and ML methods such as LightGBM, XGBoost, Prophet or ARIMA
  • Experience forecasting with sparse, short or patchy history, such as new stores or sites
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or Databricks)
  • Ability to explain model outputs and limitations to non-technical stakeholders
  • Tertiary qualification in data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field
Desirable skills
  • Hospitality, retail, QSR or other multi-site business experience
  • Hierarchical forecasting (for example network, region, venue, product)
  • Experience with foundation time series models such as Chronos or TimeGPT
  • Databricks, PySpark and MLflow
  • Weather and event-driven demand modelling
  • Promotional uplift or causal impact analysis
How to apply If you have the right skillset, please get in contact with Jack or send your resume to jack.winters@halcyonknights.com.au

job.title: Data and AI Architect
job.description:
Enterprise platform strategy and readiness
  • Experienced Data & AI Architect with a track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, machine learning, generative AI and agentic-AI solutions.
  • Assesses enterprise platform readiness across the full data and AI landscape, including data foundations, ML and LLM services, enterprise knowledge, integration, AI controls, user experience, runtime orchestration and platform engineering.
  • Identifies platform gaps, constraints and technical risks; develops practical, prioritised recommendations to strengthen the client’s data and AI platform.
Solution architecture and design
  • Defines end-to-end solution architectures for specific data, ML and AI use cases, balancing functional needs with the client’s existing technology environment, architecture standards, security requirements and delivery constraints.
  • Designs reusable patterns for data access, retrieval and knowledge grounding, model and agent execution, enterprise integration, identity and access controls, observability, evaluation, resilience and operational support.
  • Works closely with client enterprise architects, platform teams, security and risk stakeholders, product owners and delivery teams to align solution designs with target-state architecture and roadmaps.
Delivery and engineering leadership
  • Understands the client’s engineering practices, delivery lifecycle and maturity; guides teams to adopt appropriate development, testing, release, documentation, operational-readiness and governance practices.
  • Provides hands-on technical leadership throughout delivery, including architecture decisions, design assurance, technical troubleshooting, and transition of solutions into production support.
  • Communicates complex technical choices clearly to both senior business stakeholders and engineering teams, articulating trade-offs, dependencies, risks and recommended decisions.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
System Engineer
Melbourne | Permanent, hybrid | up to $130K + super

Our client is a leading global provider of retail point-of-sale technology, supplying the hardware and software behind checkouts in major retailers. Their Melbourne Professional Services team is standing up a new rollout of their retail commerce platform for a customer, and needs a hands-on engineer to make it happen.

You'll build the environments, get stores connected and support the rollout through pilot and hypercare.

What you'll be doing
  • Building application, database and infrastructure environments across dev, test, pilot and production
  • Getting in-store POS hardware, peripherals, OS images and store networks ready for rollout
  • Connecting the platform to back-end systems, payments and third-party services
  • Automating builds and deployments so the rollout scales across stores
  • Setting up monitoring and providing L2/L3 support through pilot and hypercare
  • Keeping environments hardened, patched and PCI-aligned, with clear runbooks for handover
Must Have
  • Windows and Linux server administration
  • Retail POS, store infrastructure or peripheral experience
  • Azure or AWS, plus solid networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, firewalls)
  • Scripting in PowerShell, Bash or Python, with CI/CD and IaC exposure (Terraform, Ansible)
  • SQL Server or PostgreSQL fundamentals
  • Confident working directly with customers
If you have the right skillset, please get in contact with Lainey or send me your resume to lainey.macdonald@halcyonknights.com.au

job.title: Facilities Manager
job.description:
Facilities Manager – SA State Government
Location: Mawson Lakes, SA
Employment: Full-time
Contract: ASAP - June 2027
Rate: $69–$71 per hour + superannuation
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Facilities Manager to join a South Australian State Government department based in Mawson Lakes.
This is a hands-on facilities and asset management role where you will play an important part in ensuring facilities are safe, well-maintained, compliant and operating effectively. You will work closely with contractors, suppliers, internal stakeholders and other government agencies to deliver high-quality facilities services and maintenance outcomes.
About the role As Facilities Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of facilities services, maintenance programs and external service providers across a portfolio of assets.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing facilities maintenance, including preventative maintenance, repairs, upgrades and improvement works.
  • Developing and managing facilities budgets, monitoring expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost efficiencies.
  • Managing relationships with contractors, suppliers and service providers to ensure quality, timely and compliant delivery.
  • Monitoring contractor performance against contracts, KPIs and service level expectations.
  • Conducting regular inspections and coordinating corrective actions to ensure facilities meet relevant building, safety and industry requirements.
  • Monitoring the condition and performance of buildings, plant and equipment and developing appropriate maintenance and replacement strategies.
  • Working with internal teams and external partners to plan and deliver facilities improvement projects.
  • Responding to and resolving facilities-related issues, complaints and stakeholder concerns.
  • Building strong relationships with a broad range of stakeholders and providing practical advice on facilities matters.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve facilities processes, systems and service delivery.
About you We are looking for an experienced facilities or property professional who can confidently manage competing priorities, contractors and stakeholder expectations.
You will ideally have:
  • Demonstrated experience in facilities, property or asset management.
  • Strong experience managing contractors, suppliers and service providers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing budgets and monitoring expenditure.
  • Strong knowledge of facilities maintenance, compliance and building requirements.
  • The ability to identify issues, assess options and implement practical solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in property or a related discipline are highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Property Manager Registration is required.
What’s on offer?
  • Full-time opportunity with a South Australian State Government department.
  • Based in Mawson Lakes.
  • Attractive hourly rate of $69–$71 per hour + superannuation.
  • Opportunity to work across a varied property and facilities portfolio.
  • A role with significant stakeholder engagement and responsibility.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the effective management and improvement of government assets.
A current satisfactory National Police Clearance will be required for the successful candidate. Some out-of-hours work and interstate/intrastate travel may also be required.
If you are an experienced Facilities Manager looking for your next opportunity within South Australian Government, we would love to hear from you.
